title: Actual commands — on-premise (cm541)
subtitle: Taken verbatim from the reference run (project HN00281891, 2026-09-04..06): program_command/ files, the '&&' lines in program_log/*.log, and the server scripts. {} marks a value filled in at run time.

entries.name: Trim Galore  —  the other choice (--trim_program trim_galore)
Why Cutadapt has no station on this map
entries.note: Cutadapt 4.4 is installed and works, but nothing calls it on its own — Trim Galore invokes it as its engine. Drawing it as a station would imply a choice that does not exist. The ported pipeline adds it as a real option, so it does appear on the Nextflow map.

entries.name: FastQstat · FastQC  —  run on raw and trimmed, both
entries.note: These compare before and after trimming, so they are not a step that follows Trimmomatic in time.

entries.name: RNAQC  —  order-level QC, runs for TRR and TRS only
entries.note: De novo is appCode TRS, so this step does run. It sits in the BTS layer, not in runDenovoRNA.py.

entries.name: Assembly grouping  —  decided by merge and asm[N]
cmd: merge yes + one asm1 -> every sample in one group
merge yes + several asm[N] -> asm{N} = {group}^{S1},{S2}  (subset merge)
merge no -> one group per sample (no merge at all)
entries.note: With a single sample, merge is forced to no regardless of the setting (runDenovoRNA.py:682).

entries.name: FASTQ merge  —  the command depends on group size
cmd: 1 sample, group name equals sample name -> nothing at all (pass)
entries.note: On the map merge sits above the main track, so the line bulges up to it. A run with merge = no simply has nothing to do at that station.

entries.name: Trinity
entries.note: Measured: 36h18m wall, 588.7 CPU-h, 64.0 GB peak resident.

entries.name: Unigene  —  longest isoform, CD-HIT-EST, cluster sort
entries.note: -M 0 means unlimited memory and -T 10 disagrees with thread(20). Both are OOM risks in the cloud.

entries.name: RSEM  —  index once per group, then once per sample
entries.note: Quantification runs for every sample of the group and is never skipped — including a run that reuses an existing assembly (runDenovoRNA.py:371-375).

entries.name: BUSCO  —  only when the config has a lineage
cmd: if 'lineage' in config_dic:   <- the whole gate
entries.note: config/virus has no lineage entry, so the Virus line never stops at BUSCO — the same reason it skips KofamScan.

entries.name: BLAST / DIAMOND  —  repeated per DB
entries.note: runBLAST.py splits the FASTA into 100k-sequence chunks and submits sub-jobs back to SGE — a second scheduler, 7 chunks per DB.

entries.name: InterProScan  —  always runs, with no switch
entries.note: It is not in the db list and there is no way to turn it off. KofamScan right below it is guarded by 'kofam' in config_dic; this one is not. Measured 4h25m.

entries.name: KofamScan  —  only when the config has a kofam entry
makeStatistics  —  six categories
entries.note: busco joins the list only when the config has a lineage.

entries.name: makeResultAnnot  —  where annotation meets quantification
cmd: + one column per annotation DB (UniProt, NR, Pfam, EggNOG, Core_NT, InterPro, KoFam, KO)
entries.note: A failure here still writes the success flag: .error is spelled .ok at runDenovoRNA.py:612-613.
